#### DID 中如何回答州层面的政策问题 {#arxiv-2609-01467}

<p class="myapa">Austin, N., Karim, S. R., Strumpf, E., &amp; Webb, M. D. (2026). Which policy works, and where? Estimation and inference for state-level treatment effects in difference-in-differences. arXiv (working paper). <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01467" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Link</a>, <a href="https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=Which%20policy%20works%2C%20and%20where%3F%20Estimation%20and%20inference%20for%20state-level%20treatment%20effects%20in%20difference-in-differences" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Google</a></p>
